name: Compagnie des Alpes SA
summary: Compagnie des Alpes SA, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the management of leisure facilities in France and internationally. The company operates through Ski Areas and Outdoor Activities, Leisure Parks, Distribution and Hospitality, and Holdings and Supports Activities segments. The Ski Areas segment operates ski lifts; and maintains slopes. This segment also operates ski resorts. Its Leisure Parks segment is involved in the operation of amusement parks, combined amusement and animal parks, water parks, wax museums, sport centers, and tourist sites.
